title: metadata + objectql + service-automation: loose ends of PR #32676 — bare flow owner reads (row 11f) swept and pinned, composition ③ on a real sys_metadata host, pin strictness, prose (follow-up of #32521)
body:
domain:server#7 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVSjQBHNkZd6Eqx2XX

Follow-up of #32521 (PR #32676). Collects the review and red-line nits left after the last round, under the maintainer rule that review nits go to a follow-up card instead of another rework round. Sources: contract reviews 6832698813 (r2) and 6834563087 (r3) on PR #32676; epic red-line reads 6832051643 and 6834330415. Parked under ruling 6824949405 on #31527.

## What is owed

1. **Row 11f, sweep and pin (r3 S3, red-line nit 1).** Sweep every bare `packagedArtifactOwner({ type: 'flow' })` and `lookupArtifactItem('flow', name)` / `getArtifactItem('flow', name)` call site and classify it (still unclassified: `protocol-diff-delete-load.ts:431` and `:1178`, `protocol-class-head.ts:209`, `protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts:168`, `protocol-lock-state.ts:138/164/181`, `protocol-tenant-authored-write.ts:36`, `protocol-write-gates.ts:283`). In the package-less shape (package-less row saved last) the owner read moves from none to the first registered holder: check every reader that only asks whether an owner exists. Pin the move. Correct row 11f's FROM cell and the changeset clause ("moves the same way") for that shape.
2. **Composition ③ on a real stored-row host (r3 nit 2).** Measure the boot pull with a `protocol` service whose protocol reads the same `sys_metadata` table (the pin and the review's probe have no data driver, so the protocol's own stored-row hydration never ran).
3. **Pin strictness (r3 N10, red-line nit 3).** Assert the `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` code, not only the names, for bare `getFlow` and `toggleFlow` in ③; cover `execute` and `toggleFlow` in S2's ③ leg (today only `getFlow`).
4. **Two installed namespaces (carried from r1).** Measure the seal's warning when the two holders are in two declared namespaces (no warning expected; the resolver still refuses) and pin it.
5. **Hydration comparator.** `protocol-registry-hydration.ts:623` compares slots without a package for flow; classify it against ADR-0150 D4 and pin or document.
6. **Main's own text and one reader (r3 observations).** The seal's flow clause says "the automation engine arms one flow per name" (`bare-name-one-holder.ts:577`), no longer true on a protocol host. Bare `listRuns(name)` of a name two slots hold answers an empty list after a run of each slot, where the other bare readers refuse: decide refuse or list both.
7. **Prose.** Refresh the B2 sweep table's line numbers after the main merge (r3 N8); add "when its row was saved last" to the changeset and both `Clause-②:` sentences about the environment's flow (N9); the `flowDispatchHolder` callers are the schedule and time-relative triggers (N11); cite ruling comment 6834330415 in the body (N12).

Not on this card: tightening #32676's C3 `action` cell is item 3 of #32791 (PR #32802 carries it); the action bound to two objects by one holder stays on #32681; the third-party stored-row loader name stays on #32680.

## Acceptance

Each code item pinned red before and green after on `main`; each prose item corrected in the docs or changeset it names; no answer moves unless declared FROM → TO.

Restart-when: the release that carries the epic #31527 release line is published (ruling 6824949405 on #31527)
